title: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive…
description: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data version 5.4.0.0 contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability does not affect availability or integrity but has a high impact on confidentiality. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
